biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend registers through YOUR personal referral link, opens a new MBT Bank checking account, and completes all three requirements within 60 days: $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits, eStatement enrollment, and debit card activation. A friend who opens the account but skips direct deposit earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must register via the referrer's personal referral link BEFORE opening a new eligible checking account (GoPremium, GoPlus, GoSimple, or GoSmart) and within 60 days complete: $1,000+ in qualifying ACH direct deposits (paycheck/pension/government benefits; Zelle, Venmo, wires, and bank-to-bank transfers do NOT qualify), eStatement enrollment, and new debit card activation.
Referrer capped at $500 in referral rewards per calendar year (10 qualifying referrals); rewards may not be rolled over.
Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are met; card is good for six months only and subject to its own terms.
Reward amounts may be reported to the IRS and state/local tax authorities; recipient responsible for taxes.
Not available if the referred person (or anyone they add to the account) has an MBT Bank checking account or had one in the last 12 months. MBT Bank employees are not eligible.
Only one referrer may earn per referred person (first referrer whose link is used). Program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.
Referrer cannot see details of the friend's account due to confidentiality; friend must tell the referrer they completed the requirements.

c2.evidence: Referrer Offer section states the referrer 'will earn a $50 Visa Reward Card for each individual referred (Referred Person) ... who registers for the offer using the Referrer's shared personal referral link, opens a new eligible account and completes all offer requirements' — concrete per-referral payout.

c3.evidence: Referred-person requirements fully stated: register before opening, new qualifying checking account, $1,000+ qualifying direct deposits within 60 days, eStatements enrollment, debit card activation.

c4.evidence: No fee charged to the referrer; program registration is free. Referrer must be an MBT Bank customer (customer-only program).

eligibility: MBT Bank customer who registers on the Refer-a-Friend page (MBT Bank employees excluded). Referred friend must be new to MBT Bank checking (no MBT checking account in the last 12 months) and meet all account-opening eligibility requirements.

steps: Register your information on the MBT Bank Refer-a-Friend page and get your personal referral link.
Share the referral link with friends and family (email or social media).
Your friend registers for the offer using your link BEFORE opening a new eligible MBT Bank checking account.
Your friend completes all requirements within 60 days of account opening: $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits, eStatement enrollment, and debit card activation.
A $50 Visa Reward Card is mailed to you within 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
timing: Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements; card good for six months.
